# QR Codes Made Easy

> A free browser-based generator for static QR codes. Create codes without an account or subscription, and download PNG or SVG files.

Static codes store the supplied content in the pattern. They have no expiry timer, but they must remain readable and any linked destination must remain available. The destination encoded in a printed code cannot be changed; a supplied short link or redirect depends on its own service. The generator builds codes on the user's device and does not add its own redirect.

## Generator and guides

- [Free static QR code generator](https://qrcodemadeeasy.com/): Create a code with custom colors or a logo.
- [QR code guides](https://qrcodemadeeasy.com/guides/): Practical guidance for creating and printing QR codes.
- [Do QR codes expire?](https://qrcodemadeeasy.com/guides/do-qr-codes-expire/): How static and dynamic codes differ.
- [Why won't my QR code scan?](https://qrcodemadeeasy.com/guides/why-wont-my-qr-code-scan/): Troubleshoot common scanning problems.
- [QR code size for print](https://qrcodemadeeasy.com/guides/how-big-should-a-qr-code-be-for-print/): Choose a starting size and test the finished print.
- [QR code size calculator](https://qrcodemadeeasy.com/tools/qr-code-size-calculator/): Estimate a starting print size based on scan distance.
- [QR code for Wi-Fi](https://qrcodemadeeasy.com/guides/qr-code-for-wifi/): Help guests connect to a network.
- [Track QR code visits without a subscription](https://qrcodemadeeasy.com/guides/track-qr-code-scans-without-subscription/): Understand the limits of destination analytics.
